line.comment: * Returns an array of all the ships that have been spawned, or null if none.
* - [FALSE] = Standard Kha'ak raid. Targets a random sector belonging to the faction with the most stations.
* - [TRUE] = Echoes of the Hive raid. Targets the player's Outpost in the Ancient Kha'ak Hive sector.
* Add-Ons 2.1: Refactored for the Kha'ak Hive Quest.
* Echoes of the Hive raid, scaled by difficulty.
* Hive raid on normal spawns 1 Hive Queen, 4 Carriers, 2 Destroyers, 3 Guardians, and 10 Corvettes.
* Add-Ons 2.1: Can also spawn Fighters as support ships.
* Zero Hour: all factions temporarily blacklist that sector until the next AI update (every 8h)
